name: RowGroupMetaData
docs:
Metadata for a row group

Includes [`ColumnChunkMetaData`] for each column in the row group, the number of rows
the total byte size of the row group, and the [`SchemaDescriptor`] for the row group.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: builder
docs: Returns builder for row group metadata.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: clone
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: column
docs: Returns column chunk metadata for `i`th column.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: columns
docs: Returns slice of column chunk metadata.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: columns_mut
docs: Returns mutable slice of column chunk metadata.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: compressed_size
docs: Total size of all compressed column data in this row group.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: eq
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: file_offset
docs: Returns file offset of this row group in file.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: fmt
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: into_builder
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: num_columns
docs: Number of columns in this row group.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: num_rows
docs: Number of rows in this row group.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: ordinal
docs:
Returns ordinal position of this row group in file.

For example if this is the first row group in the file, this will return 0.
If this is the second row group in the file, this will return 1.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: schema_descr

availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: schema_descr_ptr
docs: Returns reference counted clone of schema descriptor.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: sorting_columns
docs: Returns the sort ordering of the rows in this RowGroup if any
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.

name: total_byte_size
docs: Total byte size of all uncompressed column data in this row group.
availability: Observed in the hosted documentation configuration; consumer features unverified.
